confound_description: The frozen block_index modulo-four rule maps both family and asymmetric training identity, so each selected training seed saw only one family in F1. The aggregate mixed-policy estimand remains valid, but per-seed and per-family effects cannot be separated.

family_conclusions.narrow_corridor_yield: unlearned commitment; full and analytic both 0/15

why_this_factor: The hard action set contains feasible lateral commitments and the sensor input identifies hazard side, but PPO plus a privileged value baseline did not discover the delayed narrow-corridor commitment. A training-only privileged candidate-rank target changes credit assignment while keeping observations, actions, reward, shield, analytic prior and deployment actor interface fixed.
